items.title: 4 Accident & Health Insurers to Watch Amid Elevated Healthcare Costs
items.summary: Accident and Health Insurance stocks like AFL, GL, TRUP and EIG are set to gain from rising underwriting exposure and accelerated digitalization. However, pricing pressure is a concern given rising medical costs and inflation.

items.title: AFL Q2 Deep Dive: Japan Product Refresh and U.S. Group Momentum Offset Sales Decline
items.summary: Supplemental insurance provider Aflac (NYSE:AFL) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales fell by 6.9% year on year to $4.22 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.75 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Aflac Incorporated Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: As Aflac Incorporated has lagged behind the SPX over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a cautious outlook about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Is Aflac (AFL) Still Reasonable After A 143% Five Year Run?
items.summary: Aflac stock has delivered a strong 142.8% return over the past five years, yet current valuation checks send mixed signals, with the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate pointing to upside while earnings based multiples lean the other way. A 142.8% gain over five years puts Aflac among the stronger long term performers, which raises the bar for any further upside from today's price. The share price can be supported if the company continues to convert earnings into steady cash flows...
